title: Tarot Library — Premium Editorial Archive
risk_reason: Tarot Library adds a complete full-screen educational/deck-browsing surface plus Settings About & Guide. It is additive and does not change reading selection or persistence, but the PWA Service Worker/cache identity moves to V0.10.0.

feature_contract.identity: Tarot Library is the premium educational and canonical-deck exploration surface for Little Ganesha Tarot.
feature_contract.deck_source: window.LGTReadingContent canonical 78-card source; Hindi uses the existing Hindi card-content layer
feature_contract.card_detail: canonical artwork, localized title, Arcana/suit metadata, keywords, upright meaning, reflection and six context lenses
feature_contract.visuals: canonical card art plus code-driven structural/spread visuals; no stock or unrelated generated imagery
feature_contract.history: museum-grounded editorial history that separates documented Renaissance game history from later divination/occult traditions and unproven ancient-origin claims
feature_contract.settings: About & Guide covers privacy, daily rules, Save/Share, languages, accessibility and project information
feature_contract.navigation: persistent Back/Home hierarchy; card detail restores the previous deck scroll position
feature_contract.performance: Library code/styles are app-shell resources; 78 full-resolution card artworks remain lazy/runtime resources
feature_contract.accessibility: touch/keyboard navigation, Reduced Motion support, localized UI and no hover-only information

rollback.instruction: Restore the V0.9.1 runtime/build/cache files from this commit and remove the V0.10.0 Tarot Library files if a serious regression appears.
